meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
₹3000 ke budget mein India mein kai acche aur trusted running shoes ke options available hain, jo beginner runners ya daily jogging ke liye best hain.

Aapke liye kuch top brands aur unke models ki list neeche di gayi hai, jise aap apne comfort ke hisab se chun sakte hain:

### Best Running Shoes Under ₹3000

| Brand & Model | Key Features | Approximate Price Range |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Decathlon Kalenji (Jogflow 190.1 / Jogflow 100)** | Lightweight, acchi cushioning, aur daily 5km–10km running/walking ke liye best durability. | ₹1,500 - ₹2,500 |
| **Adidas (Duramo Series / Entry-level Running Shoes)** | Great grip, breathable mesh upper, aur long-lasting build quality. Sale ke dauran kai Duramo models ₹2,500 - ₹3,000 ke andar mil jaate hain. | ₹2,200 - ₹3,000 |
| **Campus (Active / Running Shoes)** | Budget-friendly, soft cushioning, aur India mein kaafi popular hain daily use ke liye. | ₹1,200 - ₹2,000 |
| **Puma (Conduct Pro / Entry Performance)** | Stylish looks ke sath accha arch support aur shock absorption. Sale mein acche options milte hain. | ₹2,000 - ₹3,000 |
| **HRX by Hrithik Roshan** | Lightweight, flex grooves ke sath jo running ke waqt flexibility dete hain. | ₹1,500 - ₹2,500 |

---

### Kuch Zaroori Baatein (Buying Tips):

1.  **Sale ka Fayda Lein:** Myntra, Flipkart, Amazon, ya Adidas/Puma ki official websites par aksar discounts chalte rehte hain, jisme ₹4,000–₹5,000 tak ke shoes ₹3,000 ke andar mil jaate hain.
2.  **Size Selection:** Running shoes hamesha apne regular shoe size se **1 size bada** (ya 0.5 cm extra room ke sath) kharidein, kyunki दौड़te waqt ya walk karte waqt pair thode phoolte hain (swell hote hain).

Kya aapko yeh shoes kisi specific use ke liye chahiye (jaise sirf morning walk, treadmill, ya regular running), ya aapko koi specific brand pasand hai?
